tme_demo_tme_demo_tenant_update.description: Update a tme-demo tenant service. Use this for tenant VPN or data-centre changes, including adding endpoints.

l3vpn.description: Optional. Include only for L3VPN service changes.

route-distinguisher.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the route distinguisher/target identifier.

qos-policy.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the VPN QoS policy.

endpoint.description: Optional. Include only VPN endpoints/sites to add or update.

ce-interface.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the CE local interface.

ip-network.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the CE interface private IPv4 prefix.

as-number.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the CE device AS number.

bandwidth.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing endpoint bandwidth in bps.

data-centre.description: Optional. Include only for data centre connectivity changes.

vlan.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the data centre tenant VLAN.

ip-network.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing the data centre private IPv4 prefix.

preserve-vlan-tags.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing VLAN tag preservation.

endpoint.description: Optional. Include only data centre endpoints to add or update.

connect-multiple-vlans.description: Optional. Include only when setting or changing access port trunking.

__commit_dry_run.description: Optional. Set to true when the user asks to preview the tenant update without applying it.

__commit_dry_run_format.description: Optional. Output format for commit dry-run results.

tme_demo_tme_demo_tenant_re_deploy.description: Redeploy an existing tme-demo tenant service.

dry-run.description: Optional. Include when the user asks to preview the redeploy without applying it. Use an empty object unless a dry-run output format is explicitly requested.

outformat.description: Optional. Dry-run output format. Only include when the user explicitly asks for a specific format.

with-service-meta-data.description: Optional. Include only when the user asks for service metadata in dry-run output.

reconcile.description: Optional. Include only when the user asks to reconcile service ownership of existing device configuration.

attach-non-service-config.description: Optional. Attach existing non-service configuration to the service.

detach-non-service-config.description: Optional. Detach non-service configuration from the service.

devices_device_sync_from.description: Sync one NSO device from the network.

devices_device_check_sync.description: Check whether one NSO device is in sync.

devices_device_compare_config.description: Compare one NSO device config against NSO intended config.
